I ran the search for Manchester to Geneva (12–19 September, two passengers, economy), but flight search is currently unavailable, so I couldn't retrieve live fares — and I won't guess at prices, because a made-up number is worse than none.

What I can tell you about the route while the search is down: Manchester–Geneva is well served in September, with direct services from easyJet and one-stop options via Amsterdam, Paris or Zurich on KLM, Air France and SWISS. Flight time is around 1h50 direct. Mid-September is shoulder season for Geneva, so seat availability is normally good, and midweek departures on this route tend to be the cheapest — your Saturday-to-Saturday dates are the busiest pattern, so it's worth me checking a Friday or Sunday departure too when the search is back.
